content.question: Which statement best describes the difference between feature construction and feature extraction?
options: Feature construction creates new features from existing ones using domain knowledge, while feature extraction automatically reduces dimensionality while retaining most of the information.
Feature construction uses PCA and t-SNE, while feature extraction uses encoding techniques.
Feature construction reduces dimensionality, while feature extraction adds new features.
There is no difference - both terms simply describe data cleaning.
content.answer: Feature construction creates new features from existing ones using domain knowledge, while feature extraction automatically reduces dimensionality while retaining most of the information.
